Prompting the social.plus MCP server well starts with naming your app category, your goal and the feature you want to configure.

## How do you write the first prompt?

1. Name your app category and audience.
2. State the outcome you want.
3. Ask for the configuration steps, citing the [MCP setup guide](https://learn.social.plus/mcp).

## What should you check in the answer?

Confirm the steps match the current documentation before applying them.
